credit: Measured from Basit A. Khan's public work (X @basit_designs; Framer @basit-a-khan; Dribbble BasitAkhan; Inspirux; Grainient): live sites taxo.ai, grainient.supply, inspirux.com, hipandflo.com and 15 Framer template previews (Oberion, Fuchsia, Greenvest, Eventverse, Archar, Monarque, ...), via Playwright getComputedStyle, document.getAnimations() and Framer's appear-animation JSON; Dribbble shots read from pixels. Study material only: never ship his assets, Grainient gradients, copy or layouts. See knowledge/web/basit-craft.md.
about: Basit's register is cinematic art direction on top of a plain, centred SaaS skeleton. The premium comes from one rendered light field (WebGL grain shader, Grainient raster gradient, 3D render or photo) and big, tightly tracked display type. Product UI is a cropped, mostly standard dashboard that the light falls on. Values are CSS px at 1440x900 unless marked [V] (estimated from a Dribbble image).

seen.taxo: Source Serif 4 Variable (display 120px, italic + roman in one line), Source Serif 4 300 for UI and body, Times Now SemiLight for a 200px watermark word
seen.inspirux: PP Mori (100 weight at 32px for intro copy)

fonts.rule: one family per site (or one display + one UI); SaaS display at 400-500, brand/portfolio display 600-900; body 14-16px at 300-400

saas_h1.dribbble_V: Lowpro, Tasker, Equals, MPA: about 64-80px at 1440, w400-500, about -0.05em

campaign_h1.mix: first word italic, rest roman, same size, one line

eyebrow_pill.dark: rgba(0,0,0,.05) fill + backdrop blur(22.7px) + inset 0 4px 15.9px rgba(255,255,255,.18), r50, a 'New' sub-pill inside at 10px w300
eyebrow_pill.light: #ebe6e0 flat chip, r0, 4px 10px padding, 6px accent square (oberion)

two_tone_headline: fuchsia: background-clip:text linear-gradient(110deg, #fff 38.46%, #020202 100%) (the line fades into the dark at its end)
catalyst [V]: 'Time saved is money earned' white + '-keep more of both.' at about 45% white
lowpro [V]: line 1 mid grey #6d6d6d, line 2 near-black
taxo: italic word + roman word, same colour

taxo_webgl_grain.tech: Unicorn Studio scene (unicornStudio.umd.js v2.1.0) on a 1440x900 canvas behind the hero
taxo_webgl_grain.falloff: into black over the bottom 40% of the fold; the CTA sits on the transition
taxo_webgl_grain.entrance: opacity 0.001 + scale 1.2 -> 1, spring 1.5s bounce 0, delay 1.5s (after the type)

grainient_hero_wave.tech: Unicorn Studio canvas inside an inset container
grainient_hero_wave.position: bottom 25% of the container, a horizontal light ribbon
grainient_hero_wave.copy: centred above it on pure black

fuchsia_violet_floor.tech: full-bleed raster PNG 1440x1072 behind the hero (no CSS blobs)
fuchsia_violet_floor.shape: light rises from the bottom edge, brightest at the corners, the product window sits in it
fuchsia_violet_floor.section_dividers: planet-horizon arcs (Grainient 'Ecliptic' rings) re-light each dark section

grainient_collections.hero_v3_tiles: one hue each, bright top band falling to near-black (copper #621214 -> #100101, rose #490a51 -> #0d010e, indigo #251262 -> #09021e)
grainient_collections.swiftglow_light_tiles: pale blue-violet, grain std up to 5.3

light_saas_fields_V.lowpro: blurred iridescent 3D glass pills on #d7d5db-#e2e2e6, saturated pink/blue edges, grain std about 11; product sharp in front (depth of field)
light_saas_fields_V.equals: pale cyan-left / lavender-right mesh over a faint 1px grid, #d6dbe5 mean, grain std about 13.5; multiplayer name chips with cursors around the headline
light_saas_fields_V.mpa: one blue (#3c7db5 -> #cce7fb) with a blurred 3D cube, hero inside an inset rounded panel
light_saas_fields_V.ai_app_builder: iridescent pastel (warm gold right, pink bottom) with a photographed hand holding a phone
light_saas_fields_V.oberion: a raster colour layer with mix-blend-mode: color over #f7f5f3, pink/yellow/cyan wash only at the lower corners behind the product

light_fields.rule: one rendered field per hero, one hue ramp (or one iridescent set on light), light enters off-axis, falls to the canvas colour before the product or under the copy; grain visible in midtones (std 6-15 on 0-255), invisible in blacks

taxo_ringed_pill.hover: glow and stroke gradients move to the pointer and grow (25% -> 42.8% / 18% -> 58%)
taxo_ringed_pill.label: Source Serif 4 16px w600 #080808

greenvest_arrow_pill.arrow_disc: 34px white circle inset 7px at the right end
greenvest_arrow_pill.label: Inter 16px w600 -0.32px

grainient_lime.hover: 0 0 0 5.18px rgba(194,241,60,.2) halo ring, icon rolls up
grainient_lime.label: SF Pro Rounded 14-16px w500-600 #000

victor_key.note: a physical key: grey bottom lip, white top highlight

dribbble_V.lowpro: about 56px pills, black primary + translucent white secondary
dribbble_V.equals: about 60px, r10, dark gradient primary with a deep soft drop + white secondary with a 1px ring
dribbble_V.tasker: about 52px pills, white primary + #1a1a1a secondary on black

buttons.label_roll: Framer hover pattern on every template: the label (and icon) is duplicated and slides up one line on hover (measured mid-roll at translateY -7.5px)
buttons.rule: hero CTAs are 48-56px tall (larger than nav buttons, 38-49px); one filled, one quiet; on dark the primary carries its own light (inset white glow or cursor-tracked radial), never an outer coloured glow at rest

taxo.ctas: two 56px ringed pills on the right

fuchsia.type: floating segmented: logo free left, links in a glass capsule, CTA free right

nav.lowpro_V: three separate pills: black logo pill, black links pill, white CTA pill
nav.catalyst_V: logo and links joined in one dark capsule (logo in its own round end), sign-in + white CTA pills right

oberion.rails: 1px vertical lines at the 1200px container edges running down the page

product_framing.position: centred under the CTAs; its top edge sits at 48-66% of the first viewport (oberion 531px, greenvest 513px, fuchsia 787px; [V] lowpro about 48%, equals 57%, tasker 66%) so the fold shows only its top band
product_framing.density: one view: sidebar + header + 3-5 KPI cards + one chart (oberion, lowpro, equals); Fuchsia ships a raster of an Untitled UI dashboard

edge.fuchsia: the image is the frame: radius 30, backdrop blur(35px), violet light behind
edge.tasker_V: dark bezel (about 16px) around a dark app, a white rim light rising behind its top edge (#555 -> #646464 band over #040404)
edge.lowpro_V: white window, no bezel, bottom 20% fades to the page via a white mask
edge.equals_V: white window inside a translucent 12px glass bezel, radius about 20

product_framing.tilt: flat in SaaS heroes; 3D devices (phone, laptop, cards) tilted 25-35 degrees only in object heroes (catalyst, logistics, recognito, auracard)
product_framing.fade: product bottom dissolves into the canvas (mask or overlay gradient) so the fold never ends on a hard edge

radii.rule: buttons either full pill (50+) or 10px; cards 15-20; product frames 20-30; never a 6/8/12 Tailwind-default ladder

shadows.fuchsia_card_dark: inset 0 6px 25px rgba(255,255,255,.1) (20 cards; no drop shadow at all)
shadows.rule: dark surfaces are lit from inside (inset white glow 10-18%) or by a top 0.5px highlight plus a stacked 4-layer drop; tint the drop with the object's hue on light pages

motion.load_order: nav (y -20..-80, t=0) -> eyebrow (0.1-0.2s) -> headline lines (y 20..200, 0.2s apart) -> sub (0.6-0.8s) -> CTAs (0.8-1.1s, 0.1-0.2s apart) -> product or scene last (1.2-1.8s, y 30-50 or scale 1.2 -> 1)
motion.image_settle: hero photo or field starts at scale 1.2 (archform, bellevoire, hipandflo, bellavista, taxo) or 1.4 (archar) and springs to 1 over 1.5-2s with bounce 0
motion.product_3d_entrance: greenvest: phone rotateX 40deg -> 0 (spring 2s bounce .2, 1.4s), card y -50 + rotateX 30 -> 0 (1.6s), green blur scale .5 -> 1 (1.8s)
motion.marquee: logo rows loop linearly at about 90-100px/s (fuchsia 3698px in 36.98s, greenvest 2240px in 24.9s)
motion.hover: label roll (duplicated text slides up), fill scale 1.05, halo ring 0 0 0 5px at 20% accent, cursor-tracked radial glow

engine_gap_2026_10_11.note: same probes run on our rejected/neutral dark folds (reports/<name>/desktop-fold.png, 2x)

quillwork.light: faint lamp vignette, darkest cell #16110d, brightest cell outside the paper #696057
quillwork.problem: grain sits on near-black (#1a1510) so it reads as dirt; Basit's grain lives in lit midtones (14.6) and vanishes in black (1.2)

halyard.light: none; the pixel service map is a diagram, not a light source

basit_targets.light_coverage: 40-100% of the fold as one rendered field
